teaching.task: Predict the limiting reactant using reaction capacity, calculate theoretical yield, and account for leftovers. Requires moles, molar mass and balanced equations.
teaching.causalExplanation: Coefficients state the amount required per equation-sized reaction. The smallest amount divided by its coefficient sets the limit; product and consumed excess follow that reaction amount.
teaching.conversationalApproach: Accepted user direction: connected explanations, contractions, a burger constraint and sodium/chlorine reversal. Explain why before calculation. Avoid command recitals, forced laughter and repetitive number-reading.
teaching.openingDecision: Native burger analogy shows why extra buns do not help after patties run out. Explicitly one bun and one patty; next scene introduces the two-to-one chemical recipe.
